title: Terraform module for private EKS control plane: canary upgrade hooks, preflight validations, and health gating playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Ship a robust Terraform module that provisions Redwood Private EKS control planes with opinionated defaults for production safety: idempotent plan/apply behavior, preflight validations, canary-aware upgrade hooks, and baked-in health gating. The module should integrate with our KMS key rotation patterns, produce telemetry for upgrade rollouts, and expose hooks for autoscaling and emergency rollback. This ticket covers module design, implementation tasks, tests, and an operator playbook for on-call engineers.
acceptance_criteria:
- Module is usable by infra teams to create a private EKS control plane in a customer VPC with a single terraform apply and idempotent runs.
- Implements a canary upgrade flow toggle (boolean) that orchestrates staged control-plane upgrades with health gate checks after each stage.
- Preflight validations fail fast for missing cross-account KMS, subnet tagging, or incompatible CIDR ranges.
- Health probes (API, kubelet cert rotation status, control-plane API latency, etc.) are emitted to our observability backend and documented.
- Rollback hooks and documented rollback playbook exist and have been dry-run in staging.
- Automated e2e upgrade test against a staging cluster passes with no manual interventions.
tasks: Draft module API: inputs/outputs and defaults (kms_key_arn, vpc_id, private_subnets, control_plane_version, canary_upgrade_enabled).
Implement preflight validations as a separate terraform null_resource + local-exec check to fail plans early for misconfigurations.
Add canary upgrade lifecycle: create temporary nodegroup for canary canaries, cordon/drain plan, invoke control plane upgrade with staged timeouts and healthchecks.
Emit upgrade telemetry via metrics exporter (control-plane-upgrade-stage, control-plane-health-status, upgrade-duration-ms).
Integrate with existing bootstrapper to ensure KMS grants and cross-account roles are present before apply completes.
Author operator playbook with step-by-step upgrade and rollback runbooks and runbook links to dashboards.
Write acceptance tests: terraform integration tests + k8s conformance smoke checks post-upgrade.
Create example blueprint usage in repo examples/ with terraform vars for common customer templates.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Upgrades may cause transient API latency spikes for customers. Mitigation: Stage upgrades with canary, enforce p95 latency SLO check between stages and automatic pause on regression.
Risk: Misconfigured KMS/Cross-account permissions break node bootstrap. Mitigation: Preflight checks and failing fast with clear remediation messages + automated grant creation where safe.
Risk: Terraform state drift when control plane resources are changed outside the module. Mitigation: Document allowed external changes, create sentinel checks for drift and operator alerts.
Risk: Long upgrade windows for large clusters. Mitigation: Provide knobs for parallelism and max-surge, and recommend maintenance windows in playbook.
